paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kum ahong kivei a, kumpipate galdou dia akuankhiak lai un, David in Joab leh asikhate tengteng asawl a, Ammon suante ahihmang ua, Rabbah khua a-umkhum uhi. Himahleh David bel Jerusalem ah a-om nilouh hi.
heading: David Leh Bathsheba

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, nitaklam ninem in alupna a pan David athoukhia a, kumpipa' inn tung ah akahtou hi. Inn tung a pan numei khat kisil lai amu hi. Huai numei bel melhoihtak ahi.
David in huai numei tanchin dongtel ding in mi asawl hi. Huai mi in, “Eliam tanu, Bathsheba, Hit mi Uriah zi ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
David in thupote asawl a, ava pita uh. Akiang ahong tung a, ana kithuahpihta hi. Asianlouhna a pan siansak khit ahita hi, huchi in a-inn ah paikikta hi.
Huchi in numei ahong gaita a, "Nau ka paita," chi in David atheisak hi.
David in Joab kiang ah, "Hit mi Uriah ka kiang ah hon sawl in," chi in athukhak hi. Joab in David kiang ah Uriah asawlta hi.
Uriah akiang atun in David in, "Joab leh mite bang achi ua, kidouna ah bang achi ua?" chi in adong hi.
David in Uriah kiang ah, “Na inn ah pai inla, na khete va sil in," achi hi. Huchi in kumpipa' inn a pan Uriah apawtkhia a, kumpipa'n an nek ding thawnpiak azuisak hi.
Himahleh atoupa sikha tengteng lak a kumpipa' inn kongkhak bul ah Uriah agiak a, a-inn ah apai kei hi.
"A-inn ah Uriah apai kei," chi a David ahilhtak un, David in Uriah kiang ah, "Khualzin hong tung hilou na hi maw? Bangziak a na inn a pai lou na hia?" achi hi.

Uriah in David kiang ah, "Pathian bawm, Israelte leh Judahte aidakbuk a om gige ua, ka toupa Joab leh ka toupa sikhate gamlak ah akikulh uh. Kei ka inn a pai in ka ne in ka ta in, ka zi kiang ah ka lum ding maw? Na hinna leh na kha ahin bang in ka gen ahi, huai zaw ka hih kei ding," achi hi.
David in Uriah kiang ah, "Tuni leng hiai ah om lai inla, zingchiang in na pai na ding,” achi hi. Huchi in Uriah huai ni leh azingchiang leng Jerusalem ah a-omta hi.
David in amah asam a, ama ah ne in adawn hi. Adawn khamsak hi. Nitaklam in a-inn a pai lou in atoupa sikhate lak ah agiak hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, azingchiang in David in Joab lai akhak a, Uriah aposak hi.
Huai laikhak ah, "Gal khawkna pen ah Uriah ma phusak inla, athah ua asihna ding in kikhinsan un,” chi in agelh hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Joab in khua a-um lai in, mihangsante omna hi a atheihna ah Uriah apangsak hi.
Khua a mite apawtkhia ua, Joab asual ua, David sikhate khenkhat asi ua, Hit mi Uriah leng asi hi.
Huchi in Joab in mi asawl a, kidou tungtang thil tengteng David ahilhsak hi.
Amisawl kiang ah, Kumpipa kiang a kidou tanchin tengteng na gen khit in,
ahong heh guih a, "Bangziak a dou dia huchibang a khobul chin a hoh na hi ua? Kulh a pan a hon kap ding uh chih thei lou na hi uh maw?

Jerubeseth tapa Abimelek that kua ahia? Buh gawizanna suang tungnungpen numei in kulhbaang tung a pan atung ah akhesuk a, Thebez a si ahi kei maw? Bangziak a hichibang a kulh kiangchin a pai na hi ua?" achihleh, “Na sikha Hit mi Uriah leng si ei ve, na chi ding uh," chỉ in thu apia hi.
Huchi in amisawl akuanta a, ava tung a, Joab in asawlsan tengteng David ahilh hi.
Amisawl in David kiang ah, "Mite'n ahon na zou ua, loubuk ah hon sual ua, kou akho lutna kongkhak tanpha in ka nohkik uhi.
"Thalkap mite'n kulh a pan na sikhate ahon kap ua, huchi in kumpipa sikha khenkhatte asi ua, na sikha Hit mi Uriah leng asi," achi hi.

Huchi in David in misawl kiang ah, Joab kiang ah huchi in va gen in, "Hiaite'n na lungsim kipaklousak kei hen. Namsau in kuamah akhentuam ngal kei a, naksem in khua sual unla hihsia un, chi in hanthawn in," achi hi.
Uriah zi in apasal Uriah asi chih azak in apasal asuun hi.
Asuun hun abei nung in David in a-inn ah api a, azi ahong hita a, tapa khat aneihsak hi. Himahleh David thilhih in TOUPA akipaksak kei hi.
